materialFacts: The City of Surrey media release is dated July 30, 2026.
The first online sale opens Aug. 18 at 9 a.m., with pickup Sept. 13 at the Surrey Operations Centre.
The second online sale opens Sept. 29, with pickup Oct. 25.
Each sale offers 1,000 trees first come, first served and limits buyers to two trees per sale.
The release lists fruit and ornamental options including apple, cherry, plum, dogwood, maple, and magnolia.

materialFacts: The program is limited to private properties in Surrey and to Surrey residents.
The purchasing card must use a Surrey billing name and address; outside-Surrey billing addresses are cancelled.

The maximum is two trees per Surrey billing address. This scope differs from the media release's statement of two trees per sale and must be presented separately rather than reconciled into a four-tree entitlement.
All trees cost $20; most are in 3- or 5-gallon pots and are 5 to 12 feet tall.
The Aug. 18 online store is scheduled from 9 a.m. to Sept. 1 while supplies last; pickup is Sept. 13.
The Sept. 29 store is scheduled from 9 a.m. to Oct. 13 while supplies last; pickup is Oct. 25.
Pickup is at the Surrey Operations Centre, 6651 148 Street, and buyers select a pickup time at checkout.
Items in a cart are not held until payment is processed.
The page lists the August sale varieties and says each sale has approximately 1,000 trees.
The official Whitecaps release records a July 28 transfer of Sebastian Berhalter to Middlesbrough.
The release confirms the transaction but supplies no immediate ticketing, match-day, viewing, or other reader decision.
